verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions document scheduled executions and cron jobs, which covers recurring scheduled jobs rather than one-off actions. Message scheduling ([appwrite-docs-27]) is a one-off send, so it is not counted toward this story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on cron syntax and schedule management, multi-step workflow orchestration, agent/CLI/MCP-driven schedule creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand.
